cloud.description: The cloud the environment's cloud-neutral types (infra.bucket, infra.function, …) compile for.

region.description: The cloud's region, e.g. eu-central-1 on aws, westeurope on azure or europe-west3 on gcp

state-bucket.description: Existing S3 bucket for remote state on aws (S3-native locking, encrypted state). Without it, state stays local.

resource-group.description: Name of the resource group the environment creates (default: rg-<source>-<environment>)

state-storage-account.description: Existing storage account for remote state (azurerm backend, Entra ID auth, blob lease locking). Without it, state stays local.

state-resource-group.description: Resource group of the state storage account

azure.description: Settings only Azure has; used when the environment's cloud is azure

state-bucket.description: Existing Cloud Storage bucket for remote state (gcs backend with native locking; state and plans encrypted with the state_kms_key variable's key). Without it, state stays local.

state-prefix.description: Folder of the state in the bucket (default: <source>/<environment>)

gcp.description: Settings only Google Cloud has; used when the environment's cloud is gcp. The project is the project_id variable, so one diagram deploys to any project.

budget-monthly.description: Monthly cost budget in USD; alerts go to the budget_alert_emails variable

dir.description: Name of the folder it was imported from

origin.description: Imported from OpenTofu code: the environment compiles back as that root module (preserve mode), from `blocks` and its nodes, not from region, state-bucket and budget-monthly.

blocks.description: Imported blocks that are not nodes (terraform, provider, variable, output, locals, moved, import, check, …), verbatim and in source order.

lock-file.description: The imported .terraform.lock.hcl, verbatim: the provider versions and checksums the code was planned with.

body.description: Arguments and nested blocks in source order. A string is an HCL expression exactly as written (a string literal keeps its quotes); an array holds the bodies of the nested blocks named by its key (`ingress`, `dynamic "ingress"`).
